importer_changes: New asset name SK_Dink_Photoreal (4 LOD FBX in Dink/Export); to make it the player mesh set player.mesh in the character manifest to SK_Dink_Photoreal (currently SK_Dink / SK_Dink_Hands at runtime).

Material slots change from [MI_Dink_Skin, MI_Dink_Eyes, MI_Dink_Hair, MI_Dink_BrowLash, MI_Dink_Wardrobe] to [MI_Dink_PR_Skin, MI_Dink_PR_Eyes, MI_Dink_PR_Hair, MI_Dink_PR_Outfit, MI_Dink_PR_Gear]: still five slots; brows/lashes moved into the hair slot, wardrobe split into Outfit (4K) and Gear (2K).

Each slot has its own BC/N/ORM set instead of one shared atlas; manifest 'materials' entries need per-slot texture paths. Hair: alpha_mask/masked/two_sided true (alpha is in BC). Gear uses ORM.B metallic (brass and iron buckles). Skin: subsurface on; T_Dink_PR_Skin_SSS.png (rgb scatter colour x thickness) is extra and optional.
Normal maps are OpenGL (+Y) like the existing sets: keep normal_flip_green true.
Textures: Skin 4096, Outfit 4096, Gear 2048, Hair 2048, Eyes 1024.

Skeleton unchanged: 89 bones, same names/hierarchy/rest pose as HandBindingV2; hand and head skin weights are the shipped ones; garments take weights by surface transfer from the shipped hero. Existing clips (MM idle/walk, A_Dink_Fist) apply unchanged.
A Physics Asset still has to be generated in Unreal as for the existing hero.

Brows and lashes are alpha cards inside the MI_Dink_PR_Hair slot (bottom quarter of T_Dink_PR_Hair_BC): the slot must be masked/two-sided or they render as solid quads; there is no separate BrowLash slot any more.
Hair cards: UV V runs along the strands (root at the top of each strip), so an anisotropic/hair shading model should take its tangent from V. Roughness is in ORM.G; keep specular low.

UV uniqueness is per slot (see uv_per_slot): Skin 0 %, Outfit 1.7 %, Gear 0.9 % overlap (thickness lips share their border texels); Hair cards share strand strips and both eyes share one texture by design. The validator's whole-mesh UV_OVERLAP error is expected with five texture sets.

12 Nov 2026: hair slot gains two textures, T_Dink_PR_Hair_FLOW (strand direction + back-light mask) and T_Dink_PR_Hair_MSK; the hair atlas is now 4096 with a new layout (see materials.MI_Dink_PR_Hair). Asset, slot, bone and file names are unchanged; re-import the four FBX and the Hair, Outfit and Skin texture sets.
review_renders: Review/r9_poses.png (walk x2, fist wind-up and impact, reach, crouch)
known_weaknesses: Not photoreal at 1 m. Face unchanged this round: freckles are heavy, cheek shows faint pore scaling, lower-lid / tear-line detail and caruncle are texture only, no teeth (no jaw bone).

Hair cards against the strand groom (Review/r9_hair_compare.png): close in tone and shape at 2 m in sun, but the card hair is tidier and more bowl-like (less loose volume over the ears and nape), its top reads smoother, five or six dark flyaway spikes stand at the crown silhouette where the strands show fine fuzz, and under an overcast sky the cards are darker than the strands. At 0.5 m the lock cards read as flat overlapping blades. The whorl shows a small highlight wedge. Lashes are not from a strand groom.
Proportions: garments were slimmed 2 mm; shoulders, neck length, hands and feet are set by the shared 89-bone rig and the shipped head/hand skin, so he is not visibly lankier.
Folds are authored displacement fields; periodic ripple was reduced and directional folds strengthened, some regularity remains on the sleeves.
LOD3 rebuilt at 10.7k triangles (was 6.4k) to keep the face and hem; LODs checked in one Blender render only.
Not imported or seen in Unreal; Physics Asset not made.
Pose tests: idle boundary pose, four samples of the Epic walk reference (read-only, nothing embedded), Dink_Fist frames 3 and 8, two hand-made stress poses.

Shirt collar rebuilt 12 Nov as a clean stand band (low at the throat, higher at the nape, kept 4.5 mm or more clear of the neck skin, hem lip with thickness): the ragged holes are gone in r9_close and r9_body; the band is plain (no placket slit, no button) and the old lacing knot on the chest is unchanged. Jerkin hem still has stretched texels.
Armhole: NOT fixed this round. The shirt body still continues under the jerkin and the reach pose (r9_poses, fifth pose) pinches at the armpit; it needs a re-cut armhole or a gusset.
Validator: whole-mesh UV_OVERLAP error (five texture sets, hair cards share atlas tiles by design; see importer_changes); LOD0 over the soft triangle target.
hair: Game hair rebuilt 12 Nov 2026 from the strand groom: (1) an opaque cap shell that carries the whole evaluated groom, projected about the head centre into the cap rect of a 4096 atlas (colour with root-dark to tip-light gradient, strand-relief normal, depth occlusion, flow map; dark under-fill inside the hairline so no scalp shows), (2) narrow lock cards (20-85 hairs per tile, 5-10 mm wide at the tip) laid along the same guide field in two lifted layers that never dip under the cap, (3) hairline wisps and a few flyaways, (4) brow cards baked from a short strand groom. Lashes are still the CC0 MakeHuman lash cards. Acceptance renders: Review/<tag>_hair_compare.png (top = strands, bottom = cards; 2 m sun, 0.5 m sun, 0.5 m overcast, back, crown).
